name: arckit-uk-teal
description: UK Government Teal Book Project Delivery Overlay for ArcKit — 3 commands aligned to The Teal Book (NISTA / Government Project Delivery) and the GovS 002 Project Delivery Functional Standard: GovS 002 CIAF capability self-assessment, Delivery Management Approach tailoring (Teal Book Part B / Chapter 9), and an Integrated Assurance and Approval Plan (IAAP) with IPA/NISTA gateway-review readiness. Complements the Green Book business case (/arckit:sobc) and GDS delivery plan (/arckit:plan). Recipe: uk-teal-delivery. Requires arckit core plugin. EXPERIMENTAL — community-maintained, Teal Book V1 trial period runs to 31 December 2026.
